title: adenostyles alpina subsp. macrocephala
intro: Adenostyles alpina subsp. macrocephala, commonly known as Alps everlasting or Alpine corydalis, is a sub-species of the Adenostyles alpina plant, native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adenostyles alpina subsp. macrocephala include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, boost the immune system, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
